faqs.question: What size inverter is suitable for my home?
faqs.answer: Choose an inverter after calculating the total wattage of the appliances you want to run simultaneously. Add a safety margin of approximately 20–25% and confirm the required backup duration before selecting the battery capacity.

faqs.question: What does a Battery Management System do?
faqs.answer: A BMS monitors voltage, current and temperature, balances battery cells, and protects the battery against overcharge, deep discharge, short circuit and unsafe operating conditions.

faqs.question: How can I improve the service life of my battery?
faqs.answer: Use the recommended charger, avoid deep discharge, keep terminals clean and secure, ensure proper ventilation, and store the battery away from excessive heat and moisture.

faqs.question: Can a solar inverter work during a power cut?
faqs.answer: It depends on the system design. A hybrid or off-grid solar inverter with compatible battery storage can provide backup during an outage, while a standard grid-tied system normally shuts down for safety.

faqs.question: How do I register my Ligen Power product for warranty?
faqs.answer: Use the Register Your Product option on the Ligen Power website and submit the product serial number, purchase details and invoice. Keep the original invoice available for future warranty support.

faqs.question: How can I get product pricing or place an order?
faqs.answer: Use the Request a Quote option on the relevant product page or contact an authorized Ligen Power merchant. The team will confirm availability, applicable pricing and delivery details for your location.
